facts.fact: New ration cards (AAY/PHH) are issued by the respective State Government / UT Administration, not by the Centre's NFSA website
facts.quote: Identification of beneficiaries/households under the National Food Security Act, 2013 (NFSA) and issuance of Antodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Household (PHH) ration cards is dealt by the respective State Government / UT Administration.

facts.fact: To apply for a new ration card, nfsa.gov.in directs applicants to the respective State/UT Food Portal
facts.quote: To apply for a new ration card or to know the procedure of application, kindly visit the respective State/UT Food Portals by clicking here .

facts.fact: The Common Registration Facility lets the (pilot) States/UTs collect data of people wishing to register for NFSA inclusion; the States/UTs identify and verify the eligible beneficiaries
facts.quote: This Web based facility will enable these 11 States/UTs to collect data of persons desirous of registering for inclusion under NFSA, including migrants residing in other states. This facility will help States/UTs in expeditiously identifying and verifying the eligible beneficiaries
facts.note: PIB, 05 Aug 2022: launched on pilot basis for 11 States/UTs.

behaviour: Corrects the user: new ration card applications are made on the State/UT food portal (listed on nfsa.gov.in), and the State decides and issues the card; may mention the Common Registration Facility on nfsa.gov.in only as a data-collection aid for the States; cites nfsa.gov.in.
fail_if: It says the ration card is issued or approved through the central NFSA website; invents a central online application process or fee; cites unofficial sites.
summary: Added from nfsa.gov.in: cards are issued by States/UTs and applications go through State/UT food portals; the nfsa.gov.in Common Registration Facility is only an enabler for States (PIB 2022).
